name: tasqx-pane
description: A pane with your active tasqx task, the project's queue, its numbers, its standing rulings and your notes, in every repo that has a tasqx project.

tasqxPath.title: tasqx binary
tasqxPath.description: The tasqx executable to run. A bare name is looked up on PATH; give an absolute path when Claude Code starts without your shell's PATH (the desktop app).

project.title: Project override
project.description: The tasqx project to show. Empty: the project named after the repository's folder.

autoOpen.title: Open on start
autoOpen.description: Open the pane when a session starts in a repo that has a tasqx project.

statusLine.title: Status line
statusLine.description: Show the active task under the prompt, also while the pane is closed.

refreshSeconds.title: Refresh every (seconds)
refreshSeconds.description: How often the pane reads tasqx again. It also refreshes after every tasqx tool call.

handoffPrompt.title: Hand to Claude prompt
handoffPrompt.description: What Hand to Claude puts in the prompt box, unsent. {id}, {title} and {project} are filled in.
handoffPrompt.default: Work on tasqx task #{id}: {title}. Read its brief first.

tellClaude.title: Tell Claude
tellClaude.description: When you start or stop a timer or mark a check in the pane, add a note Claude reads on its next turn. It starts no turn.

autoStartOnSpawn.title: Start timer on spawn
autoStartOnSpawn.description: When Claude launches a subagent whose prompt names a tasqx task (`tasqx show <id>`, `task/<id>-`, `tasqx task #<id>`), start that task's timer unless it runs already.

liveRulings.title: Live rulings
liveRulings.description: Add standing rulings recorded during this session (this project's and unscoped ones) to Claude's system prompt, so they hold before the next session.
